description: R violation: exponent notation. 1e2 parses to 100 in any JSON parser but its token form is not integer-token form. A value-based check (isinstance(v, float)) would MISS this because json.loads converts 1e2 to the integer 100.
note: Mutant using json.loads: json.loads('{"count":1e2}') == {'count': 100} — the float token is lost, a value-based check sees an int and accepts. Only a token-preserving scanner catches this.
